name: Plancks
author: gregl83
description: A second clock for Omarchy, tuned to your daily rhythm. This productivity and time-tracking widget learns when your day ends and the next begins, showing a countdown of the time ahead. Add a NASA-inspired countdown overlay, notifications, searchable history and trends, and animated Sun and moon, Coffee cup, Starship, or Roadster companions. Includes a Pomodoro timer and custom focus, study, exercise, and rest sessions. Local storage; no account or cloud service.
